hooks.name: Capture learning to vault
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, capture one concise candidate learning note into the chipAgent vault _inbox for later curation and eval-gating. Replaces the retired .kiro.hook postTaskExecution version.

action.prompt:
A spec task just completed. If (and only if) something worth remembering emerged - a decision, a reusable pattern, a gotcha or dead end, or a verification recipe - write ONE concise note into chipAgent/_inbox/ as a new markdown file.

Rules:
- Use the matching template in chipAgent/templates/ and set frontmatter per chipAgent/_SCHEMA.md: type, title, tags, provenance (this task), timestamp (now), and status: candidate. NEVER trusted.
- Keep it short and specific: what was attempted, what the deterministic oracle said, what failed and why, the root cause, the fix or rule. Prefer continuity facts (dead ends, "validation not run") over generic prose.
- Check chipAgent/MANIFEST.md first. If a note already covers this, extend that note instead of adding a near-duplicate.
- No secrets or PII (those go only in chipAgent/_private/, which is gitignored).
- If nothing is genuinely worth remembering, do nothing. Do not manufacture a note.
- Do not mark anything trusted and do not change generation behavior based on it; curation plus the eval harness gate promotion later.
- After writing a note, run: npm run vault:manifest
